propositions: Eight Jira-specific modules (acli*.py, adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must be physically moved from package root into adapters/jira/ as a single atomic change.
Lazy loader must be taught relative subpaths for location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) without breaking ~30 other root-level module lookups.

All surviving intra-adapter and root-level dotted imports plus sibling path references to moved modules must be repointed atomically, including jira_fields.py:18, inbound_fields.py:36, and acli_cli_ops.py:36.

Category-2 and category-3 test targets (path constants and dotted imports respectively) must be rewritten to reference new adapters.jira.* paths, while category-1 path-agnostic patch.object sites remain unaffected.
No re-export shim, no intermediate state, and zero references to old root paths must remain in src/ and tests/ after the move.
Full integration test suite, loader test for location-pinned modules, and structural grep gate must all pass to verify the move is complete and scoped.
